Yes, you can switch to NZD:

1. Go to **Settings** > **Client profile**.
2. Choose **NZD** as the **Currency**.
3. Select **Save client profile**.

This changes the currency symbol shown on every deal, but it doesn't convert existing values. If any deal amounts were entered in US dollars, you'll need to update them yourself. To do that, open the deal, select **Edit**, enter the new amount in **Value** (numbers only, no symbol) and select **Save deal**.
